metadata.scenario: A prospective tenant contacts the real estate office to inquire about available rental properties in the city. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Karen Lewis. I'm calling because my husband is going to have cardiac surgery next month and we need post-operative care. Hi Karen, it's nice to meet you. I can definitely help with that. Can you tell me more about his specific needs? Sure! He will need help with medication management and possibly some physical therapy afterward. That sounds like a plan. We offer skilled nursing care for medication management, which is $95 to $125 per visit. Okay, how long does each visit usually last? Each visit typically lasts from one to two hours, depending on the level of care required. That makes sense. What about physical therapy? Our physical therapy sessions are priced between $110 and $140, lasting about 45 to 60 minutes each. Great! Do you have availability for both skilled nursing and physical therapy after his surgery? Yes, we can coordinate both services. We’ll need to discuss the schedule based on his recovery. Sounds good. What do I need to do to get started? First, we'll need to develop a care plan. I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, for that. That would be great. I want to make sure everything is in place before his surgery. Absolutely, that's important. Would you like me to arrange a time for Lisa to call you? Yes, please. Can you have her reach out to me this week? Of course! I’ll ensure she contacts you. What’s the best number for her to reach you at? My number is +13165552147. Thank you, Karen. I’ll pass that along to Lisa. I appreciate it. Is there anything else I should consider? Just be prepared to discuss any insurance details, as we’ll need that for authorization. Got it! I’ll have that ready. Thanks again for your help. You’re welcome! We’re here to support you and your husband. Have a great day! You too, bye! Bye!
